mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND rm.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id AND ur.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sort
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, parent_id, name, path, component, permission, icon, sort, enabled FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND enabled = #{enabled}
ORDER BY sort
